# Hosted Skills starter

Read the root `AGENTS.md` and `README.md`. Canonical authoring skills are in
`plugin/skills`. Initial user workspace setup follows `start.md` and installs
only the selected host's configuration after preview/approval. Do not bootstrap
the workspace merely to maintain this distribution or duplicate a native plugin.

Do not automatically run the migration skill, download app files over starter
configuration, or create a Dev Container. Provisioning, external side effects,
deployment, commits, and publishing require separate user authorization.
